outcome.technical: New pure module plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_affected_tests.py (390 lines): changed_paths() reads `git diff --name-status -z -M` (rename = both paths, deletion = old path, copy = new path); select(changed, meta, facts, exclude) walks the arms in order - related (meta.phaseGate.derived.listing.related, behind the same versionCheckFailed / verifiedOn.answer checks _gate_derive._importers_arm applies), python (stdlib ast import graph: absolute, relative and bare-basename imports with parent packages, plus a *.py name handed to a loader-named call; one reverse walk from the changed modules; a test that does not parse is selected with that basis; a deleted module stays a node), e2e-changed (new listing.e2eChanged key), coupling (reuses _gate_derive._coupling_arm), e2e-widening (every e2e spec when app source changed and no recorded listing sees e2e). A listing that exits non-zero, a version mismatch or failed version command, a .py change with no sources read, or no path-scoped spelling (entries_for asks _gate_derive.resolve_shape / repointed_by_runner) returns widen with the reason - never an empty selection. run-test-gate.py: task-scope runs (--task, not --own, the task's OWN gate) now run declared gate + affected steps named `affected/<arm>: <suites>` (or `affected/phase-gate: <key>` when widened), so the evidence row's steps attribute each suite to its arm; reasons are printed as `[run-test-gate] affected: ...` and carried in --json as res.affected; the gate digest and the `published` list stay the task's declared gate (plus widened manifest commands); a task whose gate already carries every phase-gate entry, or that borrows the phase gate, adds nothing and prints nothing. Changed paths: git diff -M HEAD + untracked in the tree measured; in the shared project tree filtered to the task's declared files, in --tree taken whole. Phase sign-off gate untouched (meta.phaseGate.mode narrowing stays opt-in). _manifest_phases: listing.e2eChanged held to related's shape/placeholder rules (codes phases.phase_gate_derived.listing-e2e-changed-shape/-placeholder; the related loop is shared). Schema: listing.e2eChanged property (description kept to 25 chars because test__help p5 bounds the help payload at < 200000 and HEAD already sat at about 199950; it is now 199987). _deps.LAYERS: _affected_tests one layer above _gate_derive.
